description: This script provides functionality for summarizing and reporting cost usage data related to Codex model usage, either for the current model or for all models, based on local JSON logs or live data fetched via the CodexBar CLI. It includes command-line argument parsing, data processing, and output rendering in text or JSON format.

classes.name: ModelCost
classes.description: Data class representing a model and its associated cost.

methods.name: int positive_int(value: str)
methods.description: Converts a string to a positive integer, raising an error if invalid.

methods.name: None eprint(msg: str)
methods.description: Prints a message to standard error.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] run_codexbar_cost(provider: str)
methods.description: Executes the 'codexbar cost' CLI command and parses its JSON output.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] load_payload(input_path: Optional[str], provider: str)
methods.description: Loads JSON payload either from a file/stdin or from live data via 'run_codexbar_cost'.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] parse_daily_entries(payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Extracts daily cost entries from the payload.

methods.name: Optional[date] parse_date(value: str)
methods.description: Parses a date string into a date object.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] filter_by_days(entries: List[Dict[str, Any]], days: Optional[int])
methods.description: Filters cost entries to include only those within the specified number of days.

methods.name: Dict[str,float] aggregate_costs(entries: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Aggregates costs per model from the entries.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] pick_current_model(entries: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Selects the current model based on latest date or usage from the entries.

methods.name: str usd(value: Optional[float])
methods.description: Formats a float value as USD currency string.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[float]] latest_day_cost(entries: List[Dict[str, Any]], model: str)
methods.description: Finds the latest day and associated cost for a specific model.

methods.name: str render_text_current( provider: str, model: str, latest_date: Optional[str], total_cost: Optional[float], latest_cost: Optional[float], latest_cost_date: Optional[str], entry_count: int, )
methods.description: Generates a text report for current model usage.

methods.name: str render_text_all(provider: str, totals: Dict[str, float])
methods.description: Generates a text report summarizing all models and their costs.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] build_json_current( provider: str, model: str, latest_date: Optional[str], total_cost: Optional[float], latest_cost: Optional[float], latest_cost_date: Optional[str], entry_count: int, )
methods.description: Builds a JSON object representing the current model report.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] build_json_all(provider: str, totals: Dict[str, float])
methods.description: Builds a JSON object summarizing costs for all models.

methods.name: int main()
methods.description: Main entry point for the script; handles argument parsing and orchestrates data processing and output.
